URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/21/guyana-reports-ferry-disaster-death-toll-rises-to-53
Al Jazeera (AFP), 21 Jul 2026 20:54 GMT (recovery continues Wed 22 Jul) — Guyana raised the MV Barima ferry death toll to at least 53 (revised twice Tuesday, from 41). 76 rescued. Vessel carried 179 people when it capsized Saturday night off the coast, though the manifest listed only 133. Public Works Minister Juan Edghill: "the country's worst maritime disaster in decades." 16 vessels deployed; French and local divers leading operations. Ferry was travelling Georgetown -> Port Kaituma in inland Essequibo region. Authorities cite the incomplete manifest and possible crew drug use as factors; captain and at least one crew member detained after testing positive for marijuana. President Irfaan Ali declared three days of national mourning. (Guyana is in a territorial dispute with Venezuela over oil-rich Essequibo.)
NOTE: Approved toll = 53 (AJ/AFP, Tue evening). Non-approved local outlets (OilNOW, Kaieteur) reported higher figures Wed; use only the AJ-confirmed 53 and note recovery ongoing.
